high_level_description: The image shows a single decorative tile placed on a wooden surface. The tile is square-shaped with a white background and features an intricate design in shades of blue, brown, and yellow. The central part of the tile has a floral motif with a blue flower at its core, surrounded by swirling patterns and additional floral elements. The outer edges of the tile have a border with more detailed floral and leaf-like designs. The wooden surface beneath the tile appears to be a rustic or weathered piece of wood, possibly a table or a floor, with visible grain and some knots.
